message.content: The APOE SNP **rs7412** (the “ε2” allele) is relatively common in people of European ancestry.  In large population‑genetic studies (e.g., 1000 Genomes, gnomAD), the minor allele frequency (MAF) for rs7412 in European populations is roughly **10 – 12 %** (≈ 0.10–0.12).  This means that about one in ten European individuals carries at least one copy of the rs7412 allele.
